teamMembers.name: Rajesh Sharma
teamMembers.bio: With over 25 years of experience in the construction industry, Rajesh founded Krisha Bhumi with a vision to transform the construction landscape in India.

teamMembers.name: Priya Patel
teamMembers.bio: Priya oversees all operational aspects of our projects, ensuring timely delivery and maintaining our high quality standards.

teamMembers.name: Vikram Singh
teamMembers.bio: Vikram brings creative vision and technical expertise to our projects, specializing in sustainable design and innovative building solutions.

teamMembers.name: Ananya Desai
teamMembers.bio: Ananya manages our largest projects, coordinating teams and resources to ensure successful project execution from start to finish.

testimonials.quote: Krisha Bhumi transformed our vision into reality. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality exceeded our expectations.
testimonials.author: Amit Joshi

testimonials.quote: Working with this team was a seamless experience. They delivered our commercial complex on time and within budget, with exceptional craftsmanship.
testimonials.author: Meera Shah

testimonials.quote: Their innovative approach to sustainable construction helped us achieve our green building certification while creating a beautiful, functional space.
testimonials.author: Rahul Kapoor

timelineEvents.title: Company Founded
timelineEvents.description: Krisha Bhumi was established as a small residential construction company with just 5 employees.

timelineEvents.title: First Major Project
timelineEvents.description: Completed our first major residential complex, establishing our reputation for quality and reliability.

timelineEvents.title: Expansion into Commercial
timelineEvents.description: Expanded our services to include commercial construction, doubling our team size and project capacity.

timelineEvents.title: Sustainable Building Initiative
timelineEvents.description: Launched our sustainable building initiative, committing to eco-friendly construction practices.

timelineEvents.title: Infrastructure Division
timelineEvents.description: Added infrastructure projects to our portfolio, working on roads, bridges, and public facilities.

timelineEvents.title: Digital Transformation
timelineEvents.description: Implemented cutting-edge technology solutions to enhance project management and client experience.
